scripts.start: npm run install:all && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed -- --if-empty && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed -- --if-empty && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
